articles.title: Cardano whales now hold 67% of ADA supply in highest share since 2020
articles.snippet: Wallets holding at least one million ADA now control 25.09 billion tokens, the highest share since July 2020, even as Cardano's TVL has bled to $137 million from a December 2024 peak of $686 million, per Santiment and DefiLlama data.

articles.title: BloFin War of Whales 2026 Grand Prix opens registration for $5M trading championship
articles.snippet: BloFin, a prominent global cryptocurrency exchange, has officially opened registration for its highly anticipated trading competition, the WOW (War of Whales) 2026 Grand Prix.

articles.title: Bitcoin trades at a 'discount' on Coinbase: Is a $76K retest next?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $79,000 defense proves that the Coinbase discount is driven by stablecoin volatility rather than a lack of institutional demand.

articles.title: NFL All Day Stops Issuing NFTs as Dapper Labs Signals Future Plans With League
articles.snippet: Dapper Labs said it has signed a new licensing agreement with the NFL as it discontinues the release of NFTs on its All Day platform.

articles.title: Kimi WebBridge Lets AI Agents Drive Your Browser—And Keep Your Data Local
articles.snippet: Moonshot AI just shipped a browser extension that hands the wheel to AI agents. It clicks, scrolls, fills forms, and navigates your Chrome or Edge—without sessions ever leaving your machine.
